facts.title: Spark UI | Components that make interfaces feel alive.
facts.description: A focused collection of signature React components with expressive motion and distinctive interactions.
facts.keywords: React components,Signature UI components,shadcn registry,Tailwind CSS,Framer Motion,Design engineering,Accessible components

research.name: Spark UI
research.note: Small shadcn registry of expressive React components such as a draggable pet cat, a Dynamic Island and a mechanical keyboard.

effects: Interactive Pets: a draggable cat that reacts to clicks and is fed by tapping a bone
Dynamic Island: an iPhone-style pill that morphs between compact and expanded content
Mechanical Keyboard component with a typing test on the home page

unverified: The source is public at github.com/codeweb-dev/spark-ui (MIT); that repository has not been researched in place of this site yet.
